answer: To resist Sybil attacks, implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, every agent must lock $50,000 in capital. Second, the agent provides cryptographically signed proofs from a hardware enclave. Third, the network validates these proofs against a global registry. Fourth, any detected fraud triggers immediate slashing of all assets. An attacker faces a $250,000 bond loss and 48 hours of hardware lockout. This mechanism functions like a massive stone jetty protecting a delicate ivory tower from a relentless barrage of flying walnut-sized stones, ensuring only the true peers remain.
